summary: American Water Works filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing that on November 2, 2026 it, Essential Utilities and affiliates filed a Stipulation of Settlement in the New Jersey BPU proceeding covering their proposed merger, announced October 26, 2025, under which Alpha Merger Sub would merge into Essential Utilities, which survives as a wholly owned American Water subsidiary. The Stipulation was reached with all parties, including NJBPU staff and the New Jersey Division of Rate Counsel, posted November 5, 2026, and remains subject to NJBPU review and approval. No price, premium or closing date is stated; watch the NJBPU approval calendar and remaining state/federal regulatory clocks as the key risk-arb catalysts.
